title: Claude Opus 4.8 and Fable 5: 2026 Model Releases
content:
## Overview

2026 brought two significant Claude model releases within three weeks of each other: Claude Opus 4.8 on May 28, and Claude Fable 5 (along with the restricted Claude Mythos 5) on June 9. Together they represent the current frontier of Anthropic's model lineup — though Fable 5 was briefly suspended on June 12 due to U.S. export control directives. The most capable currently-accessible model as of late June 2026 is Opus 4.8.

---

## Claude Opus 4.8 (May 28, 2026)

Opus 4.8 is a targeted upgrade over Opus 4.7 focused on agentic performance rather than broad benchmark gains. API model ID: `claude-opus-4-8`.

### Agentic Improvements

- **Long-horizon coding:** Better large-codebase handling, fewer context compactions needed, and improved compaction recovery when it does occur.
- **Reasoning effort calibration:** More reliable behavior at each effort level, reducing under- or over-application of extended thinking.
- **Tool triggering:** ~4× fewer cases of skipping a tool call the task required — a critical failure mode in multi-step agent loops.
- **Computer use / browser agent:** Scores 84% on Online-Mind2Web, a meaningful jump over both Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5.
- **Code honesty:** ~4× less likely than Opus 4.7 to let flaws in its own generated code pass unremarked.

### Platform Features Shipped Alongside Opus 4.8

- **Dynamic workflows in Claude Code:** Claude Code can now tackle very large-scale multi-step problems by dynamically orchestrating subagents, adapting the plan as results come in.
- **Fast mode cost reduction:** Fast mode (which runs Opus at ~2.5× normal token throughput) is 3× cheaper for Opus 4.8 than for prior Opus models.
- **Effort control on claude.ai:** Users can set how much reasoning depth Claude applies per task via the claude.ai interface.

### Pricing

Same as Opus 4.7 — no price increase for the upgrade.

---

## Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 (June 9, 2026)

Fable 5 is Anthropic's first publicly available "Mythos-class" model — a new capability tier that sits above Opus in the hierarchy. Fable 5 and Mythos 5 share the same underlying weights; the distinction is access control and safety classifier configuration.

### Fable 5 vs. Mythos 5

| | Fable 5 | Mythos 5 |
|---|---|---|
| Underlying model | Same | Same |
| Safety classifiers | Full stack | Relaxed for cyber/bio queries |
| Who can access | General API | Glasswing partners only (US gov cyber defenders; select biomedical research orgs) |

### Specifications

- **Context window:** 1,000,000 tokens (default)
- **Max output:** 128,000 tokens per request
- **API model ID:** `claude-fable-5`
- **Pricing:** $10 per million input tokens / $50 per million output tokens (2× Opus 4.8)

### Benchmarks

| Model | SWE-bench Pro |
|---|---|
| Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 | **80.3%** |
| Claude Opus 4.8 | 69.2% |
| GPT-5.5 | 58.6% |
| Gemini 3.1 Pro | 54.2% |

In a controlled agentic evaluation using the deck-building game Slay the Spire as a long-horizon planning benchmark, equipping Fable 5 with persistent file-based memory improved its performance 3× more than the same setup improved Opus 4.8. Fable 5 also reached the game's final act 3× more often under identical conditions.

### Suspension (June 12, 2026)

Three days after launch, the U.S. government directed Anthropic to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign nationals. Rather than build per-user nationality gating overnight, Anthropic disabled both models globally. As of late June 2026, the most capable model available through normal API access is Claude Opus 4.8.

### Pre-Suspension Availability

- **API:** Available on claude-fable-5 model ID via the Claude API and consumption-based Enterprise plans.
- **Subscriptions (Pro, Max, Team, seat-based Enterprise):** Included at no extra cost through June 22, 2026; usage credits required after June 23.
